designationHistory.name: Pettaquamscutt Cove National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Nov. 5, 1988, as Pettaquamscutt Cove National Wildlife Refuge by act of Congress (P.L. 100-610), signed by President Ronald Reagan; later renamed for Sen. John H. Chafee.
